name: state
meaning: CatapultState

name: armAngle
meaning: pulled-back arm angle = 0xe60 + power*0x140/1024; SetArmPose input

name: power
meaning: throw power 0..0x400 (set in state 1); 0x200 = trajectory P2 exactly

name: powerGauge
meaning: HUD gauge quad from GameRes 71 DAV_IDI_ICTJAUG1 at (8,16)

name: activationBox
meaning: PROPERTY ACTIVATIONBOX (XZ test)

name: mobileCamera
meaning: PROPERTY MOBILECAMERA camera setup {focal; rot[3]; Vec3s pos}, used to follow the thrown object

name: camHoldMs
meaning: 2000 after a landing/hit; the camera is released when it runs out

name: launchDelayMs
meaning: state 4 delay, set to 1 by Launch (one update)

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: 1 while this catapult holds the Wolf frozen (msg 0xe sent; 0xf on release)

name: powerSound
meaning: handle of looping sound 0x76 while power is adjusted

name: offset0
meaning: PROPERTY OFFSET0: horizontal offset of the arm pivot

name: h0
meaning: PROPERTY H0: pivot height

name: armLength1
meaning: PROPERTY ARMLENGTH1

name: armLength2
meaning: PROPERTY ARMLENGTH2

name: armLength3
meaning: PROPERTY ARMLENGTH3

name: bucketExtent
meaning: bucket box half-extents from the model's last flag-1 box (halved on the cross axes)

name: bucketBox
meaning: world-space bucket box (flags 0xa8, min 0xac, max 0xb2): collision (bit4), ground query, occupancy

name: stateJustEntered
meaning: 1 from SetState until the next Update; blocks the entering press from exiting state 1

name: bucketObjs
meaning: objects in the bucket (ScanBucket); [0] is the one thrown

name: bucketCount
meaning: count for bucketObjs; > 1 refuses to launch

name: maxThrowOffset
meaning: MAXDIST along the TRAJECTORY P0->P2 XZ direction; scaled by (power-0x200)/512

name: maxDist
meaning: PROPERTY MAXDIST

name: arc
meaning: embedded LaunchArc: coeffs 0x108, t 0x12c (0..0x100), camera 0x130, obj 0x134 (thrown object), camParam 0x138, flags 0x13c; the arc math is inlined in Catapult_Update

name: trajectory
meaning: PROPERTY TRAJECTORY export {u16 3; Vec3s P0,P1,P2} or NULL

name: thrownLastPos
meaning: thrown object's position last frame (arc delta base)

name: catFlags
meaning: CatapultFlags

name: landingTarget
meaning: P2 + power offset, shifted by FindFreeLandingSpot (x/z used as the arc end)

name: armSwingT
meaning: 0..0x100 arm swing (state 2, +g_dtMs>>3) / return (state 3, +g_dtMs>>2) parameter
